scenarios.name: Sum numbers given one per line
scenarios.reason:
Entered 1, 2, and 4 on separate lines in the top calculator’s Input field.
Selected the first Number Delimiter option while keeping the default line-break separator.
The calculator’s Total displayed 7, completing the requested check.
